Author: Beanie
Name: NoMoreEquals 不要等號
Punchline: No more Chinese characters loss in game. 不要再給我等號了==
Description:
While typing in ChatLog, replaces AXIS-missing Chinese glyphs with Japanese kanji (綠→緑, 黑→黒, 每→毎), and supports custom phrase replacements (你→尼, 懂→明白). Built-in glyph pairs are filtered against live AXIS coverage so characters that already display (圖, 邊, 國, 學, …) stay untouched.

Commands: /nme or /nomoreequals
